crossRefs.note: Yahweh is in his holy temple. Yahweh is on his throne in heaven. His eyes observe. His eyes examine the children of men.
Yahweh looks from heaven. He sees all the sons of men.
From the place of his habitation he looks out on all the inhabitants of the earth,
For he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary. From heaven, Yahweh saw the earth;
For my eyes are on all their ways. They are not hidden from my face. Their iniquity isn’t concealed from my eyes.
Can anyone hide himself in secret places so that I can’t see him?” says Yahweh. “Don’t I fill heaven and earth?” says…
The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures…
Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the peoples who shall hear…
To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’ ”
The wicked, in the pride of his face, has no room in his thoughts for God.
When you said, “Seek my face,” my heart said to you, “I will seek your face, Yahweh.”
You, Solomon my son, know the God of your father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind; for…
and he went out to meet Asa, and said to him, “Hear me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin! Yahweh is with you, while you…
Nevertheless there are good things found in you, in that you have put away the Asheroth out of the land, and have set…
Seek Yahweh while he may be found. Call on him while he is near.

translations.web: God looks down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there are any who understood, who seek after God.
translations.bsb: God looks down from heaven upon the sons of men to see if any understand, if any seek God.
translations.kjv: God looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, that did seek God.
translations.asv: God looked down from heaven upon the children of men, To see if there were any that did understand, That did seek after God.
